action.prompt: A UI or copy file was saved. Check its user-facing text against .kiro/steering/tone.md and neutrality.md. Flag: judgemental words (soared, plunged, skyrocketed, finally fell), exclamation marks, puns or horror clichés, and red/green or arrow styling that implies a number going up or down is good or bad. Report file and line for each hit, or say it is clean. Do not edit.
